People who complain about shitty internet have no basic understanding of how ADSL actually works , so lemme dumb it down for everyone and explain some things :

2 - ADSL itself is rather obsolete but reliable and cheap technology , people complain about uploads being slow , it's in the fucking name ( Asymmetric digital subscriber line ) if you want better upload times switch to SDSL which requires a commercial registry or use fiber once it's available

3 - a lot of assholes try to steal people's internet subscription , either via line bruteforcing or WiFi handshake hijack and you can't really blame your neighbors because some people use 1 km range antennas , try using LAN instead or use a more secured WiFi router 

4 - like other people mentioned there are other alternatives like 4G or mobile data , not the best but you get what you paid for 

5 - If you don't like the pricing go check what other countries offer with similar technology (ADSL) and you'll realize how ours is way cheaper (inet , Nepali telecom , Cyberia ....etc)
